title: arctium pterolepidum
intro: Arctium pterolepidum, commonly known as lesser burdock, is a biennial herbaceous plant belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the relief of fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, as well as its use as an antiseptic and antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of Arctium pterolepidum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as polyacetylenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive compounds present in the plant have been reported to exhibit potential therapeutic activities, including anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
